holdings.name: Apar Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit increased to Rs 467 crore in June 2026 from Rs 253 crore in March 2026, while operating margin expanded to 11% from 8%.
The company scheduled a board meeting for October 29, 2026, to review Q2 and H1 FY27 unaudited financial results.

holdings.why_it_matters: Apar Industries is the fund's largest holding at 5.98% and was the top positive contributor over 3 months, generating 0.95% in contribution on a 15.88% return.

watch.text: Board review and outcome of Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results on October 29, 2026.

holdings.name: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd

what_changed.text: HPCL posted a net loss of Rs 12,265 crore in June 2026 compared to a net profit of Rs 6,065 crore in March 2026, as operating margin dropped to -11%.
The company scheduled its board meeting for October 22, 2026, to consider Q2 and H1 FY27 results, followed by an earnings call on October 23, 2026.
Executive Director of Special Projects N Baladhandayuthapani retired on October 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 5.43% weight, HPCL was one of the fund's biggest performance detractors, delivering a -13.59% return and subtracting 0.738% from 3-month performance.

watch.text: Consideration of Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results on October 22, 2026, and the earnings conference call on October 23, 2026.

holdings.name: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Ltd

what_changed.text: MCX incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named MCX Mineral Exchange of India Limited on October 16, 2026.
The company announced senior leadership changes on October 8, 2026, including appointments across Strategy and Training, Strategic Corporates and Research, and Product for Metals.
Net profit for the June 2026 quarter came in at Rs 413 crore on sales of Rs 702 crore, down from Rs 530 crore in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: MCX constitutes 5.43% of the portfolio and added 0.819% in estimated contribution over 3 months following a 15.09% gain.

watch.text: Approval of unaudited financial results for Q2 and H1 FY2026 on November 3, 2026.

holdings.name: Jindal Steel & Power Ltd

what_changed.text: Subsidiary Jindal Paradip Port Limited commenced commercial operations for its 12.5 MTPA Phase I facility on October 15, 2026.
Operating profit in the June 2026 quarter decreased to Rs 2,660 crore from Rs 2,929 crore in March 2026, with net profit declining to Rs 844 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.97% portfolio weight, JSPL is part of the fund's largest sector exposure (Materials at 24.9%), but delivered a subdued 1.97% return over 3 months.

watch.text: Board consideration of Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 results on October 23, 2026.

holdings.name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd

what_changed.text: The company achieved record Q2FY27 sales volume of 963,143 tonnes, marking an increase of 13% YoY and 29% QoQ.
Product prices were raised with further revisions effective October 1, 2026.
June 2026 quarter sales were Rs 5,607 crore with net profit of Rs 263 crore, down from Rs 354 crore in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: APL Apollo Tubes represents 3.95% of the fund and was the third-largest 3-month positive contributor, generating 0.786% with a 19.9% gain.

watch.text: Approval of unaudited results for Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 at the board meeting on October 26, 2026.

holdings.name: BSE Ltd

what_changed.text: Sales rose to Rs 1,566 crore in June 2026 from Rs 1,564 crore in March 2026, with net profit reaching Rs 873 crore.
The exchange received an ESG rating of 70 and Core ESG rating of 72 from NSE Sustainability for FY2025-26.
BSE shares declined along with other market intermediaries on October 16, 2026, following SEBI CAS changes.

holdings.why_it_matters: BSE carries a 3.93% weight in the portfolio; its 3-month return of -6.11% acted as a drag alongside broader Financials holdings.

watch.text: Board meeting to approve Q2 and H1 unaudited financial results on November 4, 2026.

holdings.name: Jindal Stainless Ltd

what_changed.text: A subsidiary acquired a 40% stake in a 24 MW hybrid power project SPV with an overall planned investment of up to Rs 12.5 crore.
The company deployed 10 electric trucks on October 15, 2026, targeting a reduction of 71 tonnes in monthly CO2 emissions.
The lubricants partnership with Indian Oil was renewed for a period of five years.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.92% weight in the fund, Jindal Stainless sits within Materials and was flat over 3 months (-0.13%).

watch.text: Consideration of Q2 FY2027 financial results on October 22, 2026, followed by the earnings call on October 23, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharat Forge Ltd

what_changed.text: Bharat Forge executed a Rs 240 crore investment in KSSL to help fund a Rs 163 crore rights issue by AEL.
The company signed a long-term agreement with Pratt & Whitney Canada to supply critical aerospace engine parts.
The June 2026 quarter showed a net loss of Rs 90 crore, down from a net profit of Rs 233 crore in March 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.84% fund weight, the stock declined 16.23% over 3 months, creating a -0.461% drag on performance.

watch.text: Operational progress and execution under the new aerospace supply contract with Pratt & Whitney Canada.

holdings.name: Muthoot Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: The leadership structure changed on October 1, 2026, with Alexander George appointed as Managing Director and George Alexander Muthoot as Vice Chairman.
The company participated in the rights issue of Asia Asset Finance PLC, investing LKR 10.97 crore for 3.29 crore shares.
June 2026 financing profit fell to Rs 3,805 crore from Rs 4,606 crore in March 2026, with net profit declining to Rs 2,825 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Muthoot Finance holds 2.83% of the fund and detracted 0.37% over 3 months following a 13.09% decline.

watch.text: Execution and strategic direction under the newly appointed Managing Director and Vice Chairman.

holdings.name: PB Fintech Ltd

what_changed.text: PB Fintech infused Rs 1 crore into its account aggregator subsidiary on September 30, 2026.
June 2026 operating profit moderated to Rs 137 crore from Rs 212 crore in March 2026, and net profit softened to Rs 163 crore from Rs 261 crore.
Nomura lowered its target price to Rs 1,100 on concerns around regulatory changes to insurance commissions.

holdings.why_it_matters: PB Fintech was the fund's sharpest negative contributor (-0.858%) over 3 months, dropping 32.02% at a 2.68% fund weight.

watch.text: Impact of proposed IRDAI insurance commission regulations on revenue and brokerage operations.

portfolio.statement: ICICI Prudential Mid Cap Fund holds 97.9% in equities with top concentrations in Materials (24.9%), Financials (20.2%), and Industrials (20.2%), where strong gains in manufacturing and exchanges were counterbalanced by losses in oil marketing and fintech.
interp: Top-weighted industrial and capital goods suppliers like Apar Industries and APL Apollo Tubes delivered strong double-digit gains, buoyed by quarterly profit and volume expansions.
Significant losses in HPCL and PB Fintech acted as the primary return headwinds, pulling 3-month performance to -4.56%.
portfolio.line: Gains from power infrastructure and tubular steel were offset by margin pressure in energy refining and regulatory uncertainty in fintech.

drivers.text: Apar Industries posted Rs 467 crore in Q1 net profit and expanded operating margin to 11%, supporting a 15.88% 3-month share rally.
APL Apollo Tubes reported record Q2 sales volume of 963,143 tonnes and implemented price increases, delivering a 19.9% 3-month return.
HPCL recorded an operating loss of Rs 16,122 crore in Q1, driving a 13.59% decline in its share price over 3 months.
PB Fintech declined 32.02% over 3 months amid broker target price cuts tied to proposed IRDAI insurance commission changes.

themes.title: Industrial & Infrastructure Demand
themes.text: Holdings serving electrical infrastructure, structural steel, and commercial transport saw expanding volumes and strategic tie-ups.

themes.title: Capital Markets & Exchange Platforms
themes.text: Market platform holdings experienced high operational margins despite recent regulatory market corrections.
holdings: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Ltd

macro.why: Severe swing into negative operating margin (-11%) in Q1 impacted profitability and stock valuation.
Regulatory proposals by IRDAI prompted broker downgrades and pressured online distribution models.

priced_in.text: Record structural steel volume growth and scheduled product price hikes are reflected in APL Apollo's 24.58% 1-year gain.
Substantial profit contraction at HPCL is reflected in its 23.44% 1-year share decline.

could_change.title: IRDAI Policy Implementation
could_change.text: Enactment of revised insurance commission frameworks could structurally reset revenue realization for online distributors like PB Fintech.

could_change.title: Refining Margin Recovery
could_change.text: A turnaround in operating margins at HPCL could halt its performance drag on the energy portion of the fund.

portfolio.risk_note: The portfolio has 40% of assets concentrated across its top 10 positions, making fund returns highly sensitive to sharp moves in heavily weighted holdings such as Apar Industries (5.98%) and HPCL (5.43%).
